First, notice that:

  • the truth set of "$e^z < 0 $" is $\emptyset,$ and

  • the truth set of "$z^4\leq-1$" is $\emptyset.$

So, the truth set of our predicate is \[ T_P = \emptyset \cup \emptyset = \emptyset. \]

With that in mind, let's inspect each of the given statements.

  • Statement I is true. The truth set is empty.

  • Statement II is false. Indeed, $T_P \neq \mathbb{R}.$

  • Statement III is false. Since $T_P$ does not coincide with the universal set, the statement $\forall z \in \mathbb{R}, \, P(z)$ is false.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
